channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Australia’s new visa restrictions will ban most students from bringing family: What it means for Indians
item.description: Australia will restrict most international students from bringing partners or children, part of a visa overhaul to cut net migration to 225,000. India isn't exempt, though PhD students keep family access. Existing families in Australia won't be separated.

item.title: Xi Jinping health rumours: Unverified stroke post after BRICS Summit gets ‘Community Note’ on X
item.description: Wanjun's post on social media claimed that Xi was flown back to Beijing for emergency treatment at the People's Liberation Army General Hospital, commonly known as 301 Hospital. Wanjun is the chairman of the China Democracy Party (CDP), which has been banned in China.&nbsp;

item.title: PM Modi birthday: How US, Russia, Nepal, Vietnam leaders wished him — ‘You rightly enjoy deep respect’
item.description: Russian President Vladmir Putin, and the embassies of the US, Vietnam, the Netherlands and Nepal wished Prime Minister Narendra Modi on his 76th birthday on Thursday.

item.title: Could China steal F-35 tech through Saudi Arabia deal? Report flags link amid Beijing's past record
item.description: A US intelligence assessment warns that China's military relationship with Saudi Arabia could allow access to sensitive F-35 technology if a proposed $24 billion arms deal is approved. Concerns arise over potential espionage and the presence of Chinese telecommunications equipment in Saudi networks.

item.title: 'Count your days': US Labor Department ramps up H-1B fraud probe amid increased scrutiny
item.description: The US Labour Department’s H-1B fraud investigation is expanding beyond the technology sector, with whistleblower tips and field inspections helping investigators identify suspected abuses involving employers, recruiters and labour brokers.

item.title: Health ministry bars stem cell therapy for autism as routine care
item.description: The directive seeks to prevent clinics from selling unproven treatments to families as standard treatment and to ensure that providers strictly comply with the existing framework or face penalties.

item.title: UPI charges row: Govt vs Rahul Gandhi as Cong MPs’ panel stand triggers war of words; Gogoi, Tewari respond
item.description: UPI transaction charges: Reacting to the government decision to levy a fee on UPI payments above ₹2,000 to merchants, Rahul Gandhi alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has decided to ‘prostrate’ before US President Donald Trump and give a huge amount of money to America.

item.title: East-West pipeline shutdown hits home as Saudi Aramco halts supplies to Indian refiners: Report
item.description: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline shutdown has halted crude deliveries to Indian refineries, which heavily rely on Aramco. While spot cargoes may provide alternatives, prices are expected to rise.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump warns of 'very heavy tariffs' if EU makes Canada an associate member
item.description: Speaking to reporters while travelling to an event in North Carolina, Trump said the EU could face very serious tariffs or restrictions on trade with the US if he considered the move hostile.

item.title: ‘Please bring Purnendu home’: 88-year-old mother of Indian Navy veteran detained in Qatar seeks answers | Exclusive
item.description: Pramodini Tiwary, 88, grieves for her son, former Navy Commander Purnendu Tiwary, still in Qatari detention after years. The family questions the lack of clarity on his case and the formalities for his return, while they desperately hope for his safe homecoming.

item.title: India revamps cotton testing labs amid govt’s push for global cotton and textile hub
item.description: The ₹38.72 crore upgrade will add modern testing equipment across 21 labs in key cotton-producing regions as India seeks to improve quality, competitiveness and textile exports.

item.title: Explainer: Why gold smuggling is booming and seizures are growing
item.description: After India doubled import duties on gold earlier this year, duty-evaded gold has become far cheaper in comparison. As a precious metal, even a tiny amount of gold earns a fortune for the smuggler.

item.title: India reacts to 100% US tariff threat over Russian oil, says ‘determined to protect trade, economic interests’
item.description: India said it is ‘monitoring’ the newly passed US Sanctions on Russia and Iran Act, which risks imposing tariffs of up to 100% on Russian oil purchases. The MEA reaffirmed energy security for 1.4 billion citizens via diversified sourcing and vowed to protect India's trade and economic interests.

item.title: Operation Sohan: 2 terrorists neutralised in Udhampur encounter; search operations underway
item.description: Two terrorists were killed in an encounter with security forces in Jammu and Kashmir's Udhampur district on Thursday, officials said. The operation was launched after security forces received information about suspected terrorist movement in the Majalta forest area.

item.title: MEA debunks reports of BRICS leaders falling ill after India summit; calls claims fake
item.description: MEA has debunked reports claiming several world leaders fell ill after attending the BRICS Summit in India. The ministry called the social media posts fake and malicious, amid reports about South African President Cyril Ramaphosa and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

item.title: Petrol and Diesel Prices Today, September 17: Check fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices remained unchanged across major cities on September 17, while the government cut windfall taxes on petrol, diesel and ATF exports. Check city-wise fuel and CNG rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and other cities.

item.title: CESL sweetens PM E-bus Sewa tender terms, raises single-bidder limit
item.description: CESL also allows bidders to include fresh equity raised in 2026-27 towards their net worth.

item.title: Shooting in Baltimore involves multiple victims, say police — ‘Seven shot, taken to hospital’
item.description: Shooting in Baltimore involves multiple victims, said police. Police said seven victims were transported to area hospitals with non-life-threatening injuries.

item.title: Another Fed hike to follow? Goldman Sachs says US Federal ‌Reserve could raise interest rates again in October
item.description: The US Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate for the first time in 2023 to combat persistent inflation above its 2% target. Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh indicated an improving economy while other central banks are also increasing rates amidst global concerns.

item.title: Trump to host Xi Jinping at White House: Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, Tim Cook among state dinner guests | Details
item.description: US President Donald Trump said earlier he will host a state dinner for Xi Jinping when the Chinese leader visits the White House on September 24.

item.title: ‘1% or less’: Trump demands rate cut after US Fed raises interest rates for first time since 2023
item.description: US President Donald Trump has renewed his demand for sharply lower borrowing costs after the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate for the first time since 2023, putting fresh pressure on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

item.title: Saudi Aramco eyes resuming operation of East-West oil pipeline damaged in Houthi strikes within days
item.description: Saudi Aramco is set to restore half of its oil pipeline capacity after a recent attack by Houthi drones led to its shutdown. Oil shipments to Europe have been cut, prompting customers to seek alternatives. The Kingdom may consider dark shipments to maintain oil exports.

item.title: Iran war LIVE Updates: Saudi-led coalition air attacks target telecommunications towers in Yemen’s Taiz province
item.description: Iran war LIVE Updates: US President Donald Trump is expected to meet Persian Gulf leaders on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York next Tuesday to discuss next steps in the war with Iran, three sources told Axios.

item.title: India Inc is 'prepared for any scenario' on US tariffs, but they can't be permanent: CII chief Mukundan
item.description: The move could add another layer of uncertainty to India’s trade with its largest export market, which bought $103.8 billion of Indian goods in 2025.

item.title: Zero-MDR gave banks no return on UPI merchant onboarding costs: Ex-DFS secretary M. Nagaraju
item.description: The reassessment of the zero-MDR model was driven by the rapid increase in UPI transaction volumes and the widening gap between the cost of running the ecosystem and the government's support, says M. Nagaraju, former DFS secretary.

item.title: Asia at Risk of Unrest as El Niño, War Threaten Food Supplies
item.description: Severe weather disruptions will amplify food security risks in Asia, potentially triggering civil unrest and political instability in vulnerable countries such as India, Indonesia and the Philippines, according to consultancy Verisk Maplecroft.

item.title: US Tracking Cyber Threats Against Nearly 20 Ships Worldwide
item.description: US government agencies are tracking cyber threats against nearly 20 shipping vessels around the world, according to US officials familiar with the situation.

item.title: JD Vance says Iran war will enter ‘much different phase’ in coming months
item.description: The US vice president did not provide a specific timeline for an end to US military involvement or say what form the next phase would take.

item.title: Charlie Kirk assassination: The security failures alleged by his family, explained
item.description: The potential civil case is separate from the criminal prosecution of Tyler Robinson, who is accused of shooting Kirk from the roof of the university's student resource center.
